summary: Frontend E2E for Obserra EIOS auto-connect connector flow. ALL scenarios PASS. (1) /app/connectors renders with 5 live connector cards (M365, Copilot, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Teams, SSO/SAML) plus catalog grid; page testid available-connectors-page confirmed. (2) Auto-connect with dummy credentials: filling any values and clicking Save & connect immediately flips status pills — m365-status=LIVE, copilot-status=LIVE, openai-status=LIVE, teams-status=READY, sso-live-status=READY. Success toasts ('SSO connected', etc.) shown; NO 'NOT LIVE' or 'Invalid' error state observed. All PUTs to /api/enterprise/live/{m365,copilot,openai,teams,sso} returned 200 with immediate live=true. (3) Disconnect/Clear controls (m365/copilot/openai/teams-disconnect, sso-clear) all revert pills to NOT SET (DELETE /api/enterprise/live/{kind} → 200). (4) Catalog connector Okta: connect-okta → mock connect (POST /api/enterprise/connectors/okta/connect 200) → disconnect-okta appears → disconnect reverts to connect-okta. (5) Settings sso-config-settings card renders Apple + OIDC + SAML sections. Saving Apple (apple-save) and Enterprise OIDC (oidc-save) with dummy values immediately shows 'CONNECTED · APPLE' and 'CONNECTED · OIDC' badges — no blocking Test step. Final state: all live connectors DISCONNECTED (all NOT SET) and Okta catalog reverted; owner org left clean.
critical_code_review_comments: AvailableConnectors.jsx auto-connect behavior is correctly wired to backend PUT /api/enterprise/live/{kind}; status pill re-renders from GET /api/enterprise/live after save. No blocking verification step.
SsoCard.jsx apple-save and oidc-save persist config and immediately reflect 'Connected' badge without requiring apple-test/oidc-test buttons. Matches auto-connect intent.

Minor: login form does not activate submit on button.click() reliably across sessions; page.press('Enter') on the password input works consistently. Consider adding form onSubmit (may already exist) — but pressing Enter working means it does. Not a blocker; noting for test agents that Enter is the more reliable path.
Onboarding tour ([data-testid=tour-skip]) auto-launches on first login of a session and overlays the app — test scripts must dismiss it before interacting with connectors/settings.
